_comment: The life of each painted backdrop: scripts/rooms/backdrop_life.gd, docs/BACKDROP_LIFE.md. A family sets how painted flames burn (flame: flicker strength; flame_floor: how bright a warm pixel must be to count as a flame — raise it where whole walls glow). A room may override both and lists zones in painting pixels (the texture the room draws, wide panels included): kind falls | water (floor: how bright its lit water is — darker pixels, posts and reeds, keep still) | sway (anchor hangs/stands; strength = pixels; tree: a style of data/foliage.json makes it a tree that swings when struck and sheds leaves, scripts/rooms/foliage.gd) | glow (tint) | lava | haze | stars | pulse; strength and speed are optional.
